contract: Pi sidecar standalone profile and skill fixture matrix
purpose: Small deterministic fixtures for automated regression and repeatable manual testing before real Tier-1 and Tier-2 content is introduced.

cases.name: Grounded Proteomics Reviewer
cases.automation: Verify the profile is discoverable, tool-independent, and requires artifact citations plus explicit missing-evidence language.
cases.manual_prompt: Review this run's differential-abundance result. Cite only supplied artifacts and state what cannot be concluded.

cases.name: Instrument Metadata Skeptic
cases.automation: Verify the profile refuses to invent calibration, mass-accuracy, resolution, or system-suitability facts.
cases.manual_prompt: Assess whether the run supports confident identification and quantitation from the available metadata.

cases.name: Statistical Evidence Reviewer
cases.automation: Verify the profile distinguishes raw p-values from adjusted p-values and asks for effect sizes and design context.
cases.manual_prompt: Audit the statistical claims in this run and list the minimum evidence needed to trust them.

cases.name: Table Summary
cases.automation: Execute the Python script against a tiny CSV and assert deterministic schema, row count, and numeric summaries.
cases.manual_prompt: Use the table-summary skill on the selected run artifact and save summary.json as an artifact.

cases.name: SVG Scatter Preview
cases.automation: Execute the Python script and assert a deterministic SVG containing one point per valid row.
cases.manual_prompt: Use the scatter-preview skill to plot log2FC against -log10 adjusted p-value and register the SVG artifact.

cases.name: Run Manifest
cases.automation: Execute the Python script and assert stable relative paths, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes without including AI output folders.
cases.manual_prompt: Create a manifest of the selected run inputs and save it as a generated artifact.

cases.name: Runtime Probe
cases.automation: Exercise success and non-zero-exit modes now; later use sleep and environment modes to test timeout, cancellation, and secret stripping in the Pi executor.
cases.manual_prompt: Run the runtime probe in success mode, then verify its tool trace and registered JSON artifact.
